SketchyUp IFC support: where the source of the libraries is
============================================================

The package sketchyup-ifc contains the helper program sketchyup-ifc-worker and the libraries it
uses, all in /usr/lib/sketchyup. The SketchyUp application itself does not contain or link any of
them. These libraries are free software under the GNU Lesser General Public License; you may
replace them with versions you build yourself (see "Replacing the libraries" below).

IfcOpenShell (LGPL-3.0-or-later)
  Files: libifcopenshell.parse.so, libifcopenshell.plugin.so, libifcopenshell.geometry.so and the
  plugins ifcopenshell_parse_schema_*.so, ifcopenshell_geometry_mapping_*.so and
  ifcopenshell_geometry_kernel_*.so.
  Version: 0.9.0, upstream tag ifcopenshell-v0.9.0, commit
  7ba701972f7182322e0a00db8f0e1f3de5f69840, unmodified.
  Upstream: https://github.com/IfcOpenShell/IfcOpenShell
  Corresponding source: the directory third_party/ifcopenshell of the SketchyUp source archive of
  the release that contains this package (sketchyup-VERSION.tar.gz, published with the release).
  It is the upstream tag trimmed of the parts that are not built; third_party/ifcopenshell/
  README.sketchyup.md lists the trim and scripts/vendor-ifcopenshell.py checks it against the
  upstream archive.
  The licence texts are installed as /usr/share/licenses/sketchyup/IfcOpenShell-COPYING.LESSER and
  IfcOpenShell-COPYING.

Open CASCADE Technology (LGPL-2.1-or-later with the Open CASCADE exception)
  Files: the libTK*.so libraries in /usr/lib/sketchyup. This product includes software developed
  by, and is based on facilities provided by, Open CASCADE Technology (https://dev.opencascade.org).
  Version: as built by Arch Linux in its package opencascade; the version is in the file name of
  libTKernel.so.X.Y.Z.
  Corresponding source: the upstream tag V7_9_3 (https://github.com/Open-Cascade-SAS/OCCT) and the
  source package of Arch Linux's opencascade package (https://gitlab.archlinux.org/archlinux/
  packaging/packages/opencascade).
  The licence texts are installed as /usr/share/licenses/sketchyup/OpenCASCADE-LICENSE and
  OpenCASCADE-LGPL-EXCEPTION.

Written offer
  For at least three years after the last SketchyUp release that contains these libraries, you may
  ask for the complete corresponding source of the IfcOpenShell and Open CASCADE libraries in the
  package, on a physical medium or by download, for no more than the cost of providing it, by
  writing to the maintainer at https://github.com/zygote55/sketchyup (open an issue named "IFC
  source request" or write to the address in the package's url).

Replacing the libraries
  1. Build IfcOpenShell 0.9.0 (the same tag) from third_party/ifcopenshell with CMake, for example
     with the options in src/ifc/IfcOpenShellPrefix.cmake.
  2. Copy libifcopenshell*.so* and the ifcopenshell_*.so plugins from its install tree over the
     files in /usr/lib/sketchyup, or put them in a directory of your own and run the helper with
     LD_LIBRARY_PATH set to that directory: the helper finds its libraries through a RUNPATH of
     $ORIGIN, which LD_LIBRARY_PATH overrides.
  3. Run: /usr/lib/sketchyup/sketchyup-ifc-worker --probe
     It prints the version of the libraries and the paths of every library it loaded.
